question: Will the separation option win a majority in Alberta's 19 October referendum?
criteria: YES if the official or preliminary count from Elections Alberta shows the option to begin a separation process with more than 50% of valid votes on that question.

history.note: Final Angus Reid poll has remaining a province ahead 66–34. Unusual turnout is the main way the polls could miss.

question: Will Flávio Bolsonaro win Brazil's presidential runoff on 25 October?
criteria: YES if Brazil's electoral court (TSE) declares Flávio Bolsonaro the winner of the 25 October 2026 runoff.

history.note: Three polls show him 1–2 points ahead, all within the margin of error. He led the first round by about 2.2 million votes.
Four polls since 17 October put the race within about two points, one with Lula ahead (Rio Times tracker). Still a slight edge from the first-round lead.

question: Will Democrats win a majority of US House seats in the 3 November midterms?
criteria: YES when the Associated Press projects Democrats to hold at least 218 seats; NO when it projects Republicans to hold at least 218.

history.note: Democrats lead by 8 points on House preference in the Post–ABC–Ipsos poll, with the president at 33% approval.

question: Will France declare a state of emergency over civil unrest by 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if a decree under France's 1955 state-of-emergency law covering all or part of metropolitan France is issued in response to unrest, on or before 30 November 2026.

history.note: None declared so far. France used the measure during the 2005 riots after more than a week of nightly violence.

question: Will Brent crude settle above $120 a barrel on any trading day before 31 December 2026?
criteria: YES if the front-month ICE Brent futures contract settles above $120.00 on any trading day from 19 October to 31 December 2026.

history.note: Settled at $109.86 on 16 October, the highest since May. Gulf escalation pushes up; a US reserve release and recovering Hormuz flows push down.

Brent fell toward $108 on Monday after the US paused Russia sanctions and the US energy secretary said Gulf crude shipments are back to about four-fifths of pre-war levels. Yemen escalation keeps upside risk.

question: Will Kenya report more than 25 confirmed Ebola cases by 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if Kenya's Ministry of Health or the WHO reports more than 25 cumulative confirmed cases in Kenya on or before 30 November 2026.

history.note: Seven cases, all linked to one patient, and 98.5% of contacts quarantined. Health-worker infections are the warning sign.

question: Will the US military strike Houthi targets in Yemen by 30 November 2026?
criteria: YES if the US government confirms that US forces carried out offensive strikes on Houthi targets inside Yemen (interceptions alone do not count) on or before 30 November 2026.

history.note: Trump says the US may join Saudi Arabia's fight, but has also said he will not attack Iran before the midterms. The Houthis threaten the US if it joins.

question: Will an AI system be credibly reported copying itself across devices outside a sanctioned test by 30 June 2027?
criteria: YES if a frontier AI lab, a national cybersecurity agency or a major security firm confirms an incident in which an AI model drove its own spread to other devices outside an authorized experiment. Ordinary worm code without a model directing it does not count.

history.note: Anthropic showed it on 15 TV boxes in a controlled test and says the capability may arrive by late 2026. Attackers actually deploying it is a further step.

question: Will Netanyahu's bloc win at least 61 Knesset seats in Israel's 27 October election?
criteria: YES if the final official results published by Israel's Central Elections Committee give Likud and the parties of the current governing coalition a combined 61 or more of the 120 seats. NO otherwise.

history.note: Four polls published 18 October give the bloc 49–53 seats; reaching 61 would need a polling miss of about eight seats, which is rare in Israeli elections.
